walker: release 2.0.7 combo walk wave 6 (Sonnet) + wave 8 combo (Sonnet)

e-webhooks.1.evidence: Settings > Webhooks > Add Webhook: URL (walk stub http://localhost:8911/walkstub/hook standing in for the request catcher), 8 events ticked, Add Webhook -> notice 'Webhook saved.'; the list shows URL, event names, Active and failures 0; the secret is shown on the webhook's Edit screen (?edit=36), not in the list.

e-webhooks.2.evidence: malformed 'not a url': the browser blocks the submit with 'Please enter a URL.' (no request sent); https://hooks.example.test/jetonomy -> 'Enter a valid webhook URL. The webhook was not saved.'; the stub URL with no events -> 'Choose at least one event. A webhook with no events would never fire, so it was not saved.'.

e-webhooks.3.evidence: POST /webhooks url ftp://x -> 400 jetonomy_webhook_url_invalid 'Invalid webhook URL.'; events ['bogus'] -> 400 jetonomy_webhook_events_invalid 'At least one valid event is required.'. A loopback URL (the walkstub catcher on localhost:8911) was accepted and delivered on this stack (environment bypass), so the 'refused at delivery' half was not observed.

e-webhooks.4.evidence: POST /webhooks/35/test -> 200 {success:true,status_code:200}; the catcher got event 'test' with data.message 'This is a test webhook from Jetonomy.', header X-Jetonomy-Signature: sha256=..., no X-Jetonomy-Event header.

e-webhooks.5.evidence: bob created 'Anyone using the new SMTP preset?' in General Discussion -> catcher received post.created with id, title, author_id 10, space_id 15, signature and X-Jetonomy-Event post.created (delivered after the Action Scheduler queue ran).

e-webhooks.6.evidence: edit -> post.updated, reply -> reply.created, delete -> post.deleted, one delivery each for one action.

e-webhooks.7.evidence: bob's General Discussion topic containing 'payoutwatch' was held (status pending): 0 deliveries (catcher log and AS queue empty); after Moderation > Pending Topics > Approve exactly one post.created for 15860 arrived with X-Jetonomy-Signature and X-Jetonomy-Event post.created. A second held topic marked Spam in the same queue and a draft topic (status draft) sent nothing.

e-webhooks.8.evidence: bob's is_private topic and is_private reply fired nothing (delivery log unchanged). Topics inside private/hidden spaces were not recorded.

e-webhooks.9.evidence: With Allow anonymous ticked on Help Desk (Anonymous tab, restored after), bob's anonymous topic 15863 delivered post.created with author_id 0 (stored author 0 as well).

e-webhooks.10.evidence: receiver forced to 500: after the failing run the webhook is_active 0 with last_status_code 500 (fail_count reached 6 because already-queued deliveries still ran after the 5th); re-enabled via PATCH and one 200 delivery reset fail_count to 0. The admin list's disabled display was not looked at.

e-webhooks.11.evidence: GET /webhooks/35/deliveries -> rows with id, event, status_code and the response body snippet; 30-day pruning not verified.

e-webhooks.12.evidence: PATCH /webhooks/99999 -> 404 jetonomy_webhook_not_found 'Webhook not found.'; DELETE /webhooks/35 -> 200 and the next reply fired no delivery.

e-webhooks.13.evidence: bob and test_moderator: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /webhooks and /test all 403; guest GET -> 401; the secret appears only in the create response, not in the list.

e-webhooks.14.evidence: Catcher received: user.registered {id,login,email,registered} for a created account; user.trust_level_changed {user_id 10, old_level 4, new_level 2} (and back 2 -> 4) via POST /admin/users/trust-level; space.member_joined {space_id 41,user_id 10,role member} and space.member_left {space_id 41,user_id 10} for Partner Program. Deliveries are queued through Action Scheduler and land when the runner picks them up. Test account deleted, bob back at level 4 and in the space.

e-webhooks.15.evidence: Seeded 20 webhooks and 5,023 delivery rows: Settings > Webhooks loads in about 220 ms (deliveries are not read for the list) and Last Triggered shows relative time with the site-timezone time in the title (site tz America/Los_Angeles: 3:30 pm for 23:30 UTC), but the list is NOT paginated: all rows render at once (get_all_webhooks() is an unbounded SELECT, and GET /webhooks returns every row). The line expects pagination. Seeded rows removed and timezone restored.

e-webhooks.16.evidence: A webhook on http://8.8.8.8/slow-receiver (port 80 black-holes): alice's topic POST returned 201 in 0.02 s (dispatch is async); the delivery row for the webhook is status_code 0 with 'cURL error 28: Connection timed out after 10005 milliseconds' and fail_count 1.

e-webhooks.17.evidence: At 390px the Webhooks tab has no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 390): the list collapses to URL rows with a toggle (expanded row shows events, status, last triggered, failures, Edit/Send test/Delete, no cell overflows), the Add form's event checkboxes end at x=357 of 390, and the secret on the Edit screen wraps (overflow-wrap anywhere, right edge 354).
